title: Spikers' Turf: Savouge overcomes AFP, secures 4th straight win
summary: Savouge fended off a gritty challenge by AFP, 25-22, 25-17, 32-34, 25-23, to secure its fourth consecutive win in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference at the Araneta Coliseum on Tuesday.
